senses.definition: Without the ability to reason; unreasoning.

quotes.text:
Hold thy desperate hand:
Art thou a man? thy form cries out thou art:
Thy tears are womanish; thy wild acts denote
The unreasonable fury of a beast:
Unseemly woman in a seeming man!

senses.definition: Not reasonable; going beyond what could be expected or asked for.

quotes.text: For it seemeth to me vnreasonable, to send a prisoner, and not withall to signifie the crimes laid against him.
